text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager - elevated 5xx and tail latency on inference routes. Affected: /v1/embeddings (errors spike), /v1/chat (p95 up), /v1/rerank (timeouts). Paging @Ollie (primary oncall).
Ollie: I'm on. Quick metrics: embeddings 5xx ~20%, chat p95 ~3.8s, rerank workers timing out. No deploys in the last 30m according to DeployBot? @DeployBot confirm.
DeployBot: No runtime deploys in last 60m. CI deploys: none.
Ravi: Infra: gpu-pool-c showing elevated GPU memory churn; KV prefix cache hit dropping from 86% -> 33% over 15m. Top offenders appear to be long prefix embedding requests from a handful of tenants.
Zoe: Support: 11 orgs reporting failures, 3 orgs getting >10% errors. One enterprise customer seeing degraded throughput (but still <2% errors).
Ollie: We need rapid, low-risk mitigations focused on per-route and per-tenant controls. Plan suggestion:
  1) /v1/embeddings: soft global qps -> 7; add per-tenant token-bucket limit for free/trial tenants -> 4 qps
  2) /v1/chat: reduce max concurrency per-worker 80 -> 50; enforce token-per-request cap 250 tokens
  3) /v1/rerank: toggle off for free/trial, limit paid to 1 concurrent job per-tenant
  4) Router: decrease route weight for non-enterprise tenants on gpu-pool-c and move them to burst-pool-d
  5) Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After for soft caps so SDKs backoff gracefully
Camila: Agreed. Also let's enable tracing on embeddings at 100% for 20m and preserve logs for 2h. Need audit entries for any mitigation.
Ollie: Running mitigations now (ops runbook commands):
```
# emergency per-route mitigations
rb-admin quota set --route /v1/embeddings --qps 7 --scope global --note "emergency: reduce errors"
rb-admin quota set --route /v1/embeddings --qps 4 --scope per-tenant --tenant-tag free,trial --note "emergency per-tenant cap"
rb-admin throttle set --route /v1/chat --max-concurrency 50 --token-cap 250 --note "mitigation: reduce batching pressure"
rb-admin feature toggle --route /v1/rerank --scope free,trial --enable false --note "mitigation: disable heavy rerank for low tiers"
rb-admin concurrency set --route /v1/rerank --scope paid --per-tenant 1 --note "mitigation"
rb-admin routing adjust-weight --pool gpu-pool-c --tag non-enterprise --weight 0.3 --note "shift non-enterprise to burst-pool-d"
```
Ollie: Console audit call:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/mitigations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"actor":"ollie","actions":[{"route":"/v1/embeddings","qps":7},{"route":"/v1/chat","concurrency":50}]}'
```
IncidentBot: Action logged: mitigation-applied by Ollie at 2178901258. Audit id: MIT-2178-19
Ravi: After mitigation: embeddings 5xx dropped 20% -> 6.1% in 6m, KV cache hit rebounded 33% -> 64%, chat p95 -> 1.2s. Rerank backlog shrank after disabling low-tier traffic.
Camila: Nice. Keep mitigations for 45m and monitor. If embeddings 5xx remains <7% for 20m, we'll relax to embeddings qps -> 12 and increase per-tenant free cap -> 6.
Zoe: Support: posted an interim status update and opened tickets for top affected customers. Message: "We've applied temporary rate limits and routing adjustments to restore service stability. You may see reduced throughput for non-enterprise plans. Enterprise customers largely unaffected."
Ollie: Also created a canary allowlist for three enterprise tenants that we know are latency sensitive, keeping their embeddings qps at 40. Adding via ops:
```
rb-admin allowlist add --route /v1/embeddings --tenant-id tenant-big-1 --qps 40 --note "enterprise canary"
rb-admin allowlist add --route /v1/embeddings --tenant-id tenant-analytics --qps 40
```
Camila: Please also file a short post-incident ticket capturing timeline, mitigations, traces. I'll lead the PI. We should include action item: add one-click per-route emergency mitigation button in console (reduce qps, toggle feature, routing shift) — this was messy.
Ollie: Agreed. I'll draft the PI now. Also adding an immediate follow-up: create an alert for KV hit rate <60% per-pool so we get earlier signal.
Ravi: Forensics note: early hypothesis — a small number of tenants started submitting very large embedding batches (seq len and batch size combos) which caused prefix cache churn and oversized batch formation. We need to correlate with recent SDK versions or onboarding scripts.
Camila: Handoff - Ollie needs a short break. I'm taking primary. Triggers for re-escalation to oncall lead: embeddings 5xx >8% sustained 10m OR chat p95 >2.5s OR rerank backlog >40.
Ollie: Acknowledge handoff. I'll be reachable but stepping out for 15m. Backups: Ravi then Camila.
SupportBot: Customer notifications queued for 11 orgs; status page updated: "Degraded performance on embeddings/chat; temporary mitigations applied." Ticket IDs attached.
Camila: I'll keep a 5m cadence. Also please preserve all audit ids and attach them to the postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident recorded: INC-2178-05. Next update scheduled in 10m or on threshold events.
